predictions: As with most recent seasons, the amount of stuff that goes into the week 1 newsletter prevents me from having enough space to include both the season-long and the weekly picks. But I still do them both, and then report the week 1 results to you guys here, so that we have a full season of picks. I didn't do too badly in the first week (18-8), although I did get at least one wrong in every division except G [and side note: I clearly miscopied some text in my preseason E division picks last week. Ended up making some of that sentence not make sense. Ah, well, no biggie.] == Two 1-0 teams ==

Match of the week: (C Div.) Pints & Points @ Liquor Possee. The C race started off with an amazing first week in which every match ended with the same score. That means we have a four-way tie for first (and those four are already a win and eight points ahead of the rest of the pack). This is the only pairing among those leaders this week, and is thus the first candidate for 'big match' status in C (and is between teams that made a nice offseason pickup). I think I'll take the Possee, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Shark Shooters @ 21 Dart Salute. Three big point scorers in G in week 1, and two of those immediately tangle here. On top of that, this pair was my top two in my preseason G picks, so I'm expecting a little bit of fireworks here. Kind of hoping Tony Keller makes his G debut, as I'm going to stick with my Shooters here, 14-10.

Matches #3 & #4: (F Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Bangin the Wire; Nein Mark @ Death Throw. F division was a friggin' street fight in the first week. Not one single team scored more than 13 points! Because sometimes the schedule gods (or possibly just Membership Director Heather Bohanan) smile on us, here we get all four 1-0, 13-point teams in head-to-head battles. Bangin was the only shorthanded team in the league last week, but I think they get it together, 13-11. And Nein Mark frickin' won without Whitley last week, so I'll be taking them too, 14-10.

Match #5: (D Div.) Bottoms Up @ Lonerider. These teams were both a bit tested in their first wins last week. But a narrow win is still a win, and one of these teams is about 2-0. The Bottoms actually kind of owned their opponents in cricket, and David Evans wasn't even there. So, I'm sticking with my preseason pick. The Bottoms take it, 14-10. == Two 0-1 Teams ==

Match #6: (F Div.) Dart Bags @ Sofa Kings. F division was the heartbreaker, nailbiter division in week 1. These two are both in the bottom half of the division so far, but they each were just one 501 winner (they combined to go 1-5 in 501 last week) away from first place. I have faith the Bags will turn things around. Bags, 14-10.

Match #7: (D Div.) Duck Fook @ One Dart Wonders. Another pair of teams that are likely really bummed out that they just barely missed out on a win in week 1. While I can see either making a run, the fact that the Wonders stayed with the Bottoms was probably enough for me. So I'm going with the Wonders, maybe in a 1001.
Match #8: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Rif Raf. These two kinda got thwomped after 301 last week. Of note, Rif Raf only managed one cricket point against a team up from D… so I'll take Sanchez, 14-10.
Match #9: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Why So Serious? I expect A to separate into two excellent group races, so any matchup within those groups is a big one. No way Darty Minds start 0-2. DM, 15-9.

Match #10: (G Div.) Diddler on the Roof @ Double Vision. Yep, these two are 0-1, but I think they each faced one of the best two G teams this season. Is this Vision's first RDL win? I think so, 13-11.

Match #11: (F Div.) We're Sexy/We Throw It @ Sharky's Machine. Throw It was the only F team that didn't reach 11+ points last week. But they can flip that quickly, of course. Sadly, it's Machine, 15-9.
